# Court filings: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Filings must be acknowledged to the sender within one hour, under the Court Rules 12. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a clerk, I want to stamp a filing as accepted so that the record is clear.
US-2 As a solicitor, I want to search past cases so that I can cite precedent.
US-3 As a solicitor, I want an acknowledgement an hour at most after I file so that I know it arrived.
US-4 As a solicitor, I want to upload a bundle of documents so that the court has them.
US-5 As a solicitor, I want to pay the filing fee online so that I skip the counter.
US-6 As a clerk, I want to see new filings in a queue so that I can process them.
US-7 As a solicitor, I want to save a draft filing so that I can finish it later.
US-8 As a judge, I want to view the case file on a tablet so that I can read it anywhere.
constraints: Filings must be acknowledged to the sender within one hour, under the Court Rules 12.
